start: 'Messages & offers' as owner; a gym with members who have valid mobile numbers

steps.action: Pick the group 'Gym news', then 'Closed for a festival'; fill 'Closed on', the festival, 'Open again on', 'Open again at'
user_sees: The title 'Gym closed on <weekday day month>' and the message with the festival and the time said as members say it ('6 am', '12 noon')
must_not: A box left as '[Closed on]' in what is sent; a time like 06:00

user_sees: Both = English then Hindi; the title is 'English / हिन्दी' when it fits 60 letters, else the English
must_not: A title cut in the middle of a word
Sent twice; sent to members of another gym

steps.action: Start the WhatsApp list and go down it, one member at a time
user_sees: Members in name order; each opens WhatsApp with the title in bold, the message and the gym's name as the last line; the owner presses send each time; done members are remembered
must_not: A WhatsApp sent by itself; the same number messaged twice; a member skipped without being counted

start: Other kinds as owner: the groups 'Offers' and 'Events' (amount, discount, days, plan and date boxes), and coming back to a half-done list

steps.action: Pick an offer, fill the amount and the last date
user_sees: The words with the rupee amount and the date; an optional sentence drops out when its box is empty
must_not: '[Label]' or an empty gap inside a sentence

steps.action: Close the page half-way down the WhatsApp list, open it again with the same words
user_sees: The list carries on at the first member not done
must_not: The list starting from the top; a done member shown as not done

start: As owner; boxes left empty, members without a usable number, members sharing one number

steps.action: Leave a needed box empty and try to send
user_sees: The empty boxes are named and nothing is sent (exact words unknown: screen not read)
must_not: A message with '[Open again on]' sent to members

steps.action: Start the WhatsApp list in a gym where some members have a bad number and a family shares one
user_sees: A count of members with no usable number and of shared numbers; a shared number gets the words once
must_not: A wa.me link opened for a wrong number; the family messaged three times

start: As owner; a list half done, then the words are changed, then 'Start the list again'

steps.action: Change one word of the message
user_sees: A new list, nobody done (the memory knows the words changed); the old list is still remembered
must_not: Members shown as done for words they never got

steps.action: Go back to the old words and tap 'Start the list again'
user_sees: That list is forgotten; other messages' lists are kept (the newest 20 per gym)

start: As owner; who gets these messages and where the done-list lives

user_sees: Only this gym's members; WhatsApp only goes when the owner presses send in WhatsApp
must_not: A member's number shown to another member; a WhatsApp from a number that is not the owner's

steps.action: Open the page on another browser
user_sees: The done marks are kept only in the first browser
must_not: Member ids or numbers of the done-list sent to a server
